name: nexaboard_thread
comment: A discussion thread on a user's board. Each thread has one originating message (the OP) plus zero or more replies stored in nexaboard_message.

columns.name: nbt_id
columns.comment: Primary key

columns.name: nbt_board_user_id
columns.comment: user_id of the board owner this thread belongs to

columns.name: nbt_title
columns.comment: Thread subject/headline. Sized in bytes at 4x the character limit so a title of NexaBoardMaxTitleLength characters fits whatever script it is written in

columns.name: nbt_status
columns.comment: 0 = open, 1 = closed, 2 = deleted, 3 = merged

columns.name: nbt_reply_count
columns.comment: Cached number of replies in this thread

columns.name: nbt_created
columns.comment: Timestamp the thread was created

columns.name: nbt_updated
columns.comment: Timestamp of the most recent activity in the thread

columns.name: nbt_closed_by
columns.comment: user_id of the user who closed the thread, or NULL

columns.name: nbt_deleted_by
columns.comment: user_id of the user who deleted the thread, or NULL

columns.name: nbt_merged_into
columns.comment: nbt_id of the thread this one was merged into, or NULL

indexes.name: nbt_board
indexes.comment: Listing a board's threads by status, newest activity first

indexes.name: nbt_merged
indexes.comment: Finding threads merged into a given thread

name: nexaboard_message
comment: An individual message within a nexaboard_thread: either the originating post (nbm_is_op = 1) or a reply.

columns.name: nbm_id
columns.comment: Primary key

columns.name: nbm_thread_id
columns.comment: nbt_id of the thread this message belongs to

columns.name: nbm_is_op
columns.comment: 1 if this is the originating post of the thread, else 0

columns.name: nbm_parent_id
columns.comment: nbm_id of the message being replied to, or NULL

columns.name: nbm_author_id
columns.comment: user_id of the message author

columns.name: nbm_author_name
columns.comment: Author username at the time of posting

columns.name: nbm_body
columns.comment: Message body (wikitext). Mediumblob so that a body of NexaBoardMaxBodyLength characters fits even at 4 bytes per character

columns.name: nbm_quote_id
columns.comment: nbm_id of a quoted message, or NULL

columns.name: nbm_created
columns.comment: Timestamp the message was created

columns.name: nbm_edited
columns.comment: Timestamp the message was last edited, or NULL

columns.name: nbm_edited_by
columns.comment: user_id of whoever last edited the message, or NULL if never edited

columns.name: nbm_deleted
columns.comment: 1 if the message has been deleted, else 0

columns.name: nbm_deleted_by
columns.comment: user_id of the user who deleted the message, or NULL

indexes.name: nbm_thread
indexes.comment: Listing a thread's messages, oldest first, excluding deleted

indexes.name: nbm_parent
indexes.comment: Finding replies to a given message

indexes.name: nbm_quote
indexes.comment: Finding messages quoting a given message

name: nexaboard_follow
comment: Per-user follow state for a thread. A row exists only once a user has explicitly followed or unfollowed; implicit following (having posted in the thread) is derived from nexaboard_message.

columns.name: nbf_thread_id
columns.comment: nbt_id of the thread being followed

columns.name: nbf_user_id
columns.comment: user_id of the following user

columns.name: nbf_muted
columns.comment: 1 if the user explicitly unfollowed, suppressing the implicit participant follow, else 0

columns.name: nbf_created
columns.comment: Timestamp the follow state was last set

indexes.name: nbf_user
indexes.comment: Listing the threads a user follows
